summary: Ryan Specialty Holdings filed an 8-K to disclose Amendment No.1 to the Executive Chairman Option Settlement Agreement with the Ryan Stock Option Trust, dated August 4, 2026. The amendment extends a back-to-back purchase arrangement to cover newly granted compensatory stock options for 287,646 shares of Class A common stock to certain employees under the 2021 Omnibus Incentive Plan. The arrangement is designed to keep the option grant and exercise net neutral to the company's outstanding share count, while aligning employee interests. This is a routine compensatory arrangement and does not constitute a special situation.
